description: Single column layout + light mode fix + mobile chat input sticky. Remove the 2-panel side-by-side layout (dm-panel-left/dm-panel-right) and replace with a single panel that shows either the chat room list OR the chat room view (never both). Fix light mode text visibility using html[data-color-scheme='light'] selector instead of @media (prefers-color-scheme: light). Make the message compose area sticky at the bottom, always visible above the mobile bottom nav bar.
steps: 1. Modify app/javascript/mastodon/features/dm/index.tsx: Remove the 2-panel layout. Instead of rendering both ChatRoomList and ChatRoomView side-by-side, conditionally render one or the other based on whether roomId is set. When roomId exists, show ChatRoomView with onBack handler. When no roomId, show ChatRoomList. The back button should always be visible (not just mobile).

2. Modify app/javascript/mastodon/features/dm/components/chat_room_header.tsx: Make the back button always visible (remove the mobile-only CSS restriction). It should always render and display when onBack is provided.

3. Rewrite app/javascript/styles/mastodon/dm.scss: (a) Remove dm-panel-left, dm-panel-right classes and all 2-panel layout styles. The dm-page should be a simple single flex column container. (b) Remove the @media (width <= 767px) responsive breakpoint for panels (no longer needed). (c) Replace the @media (prefers-color-scheme: light) section at the bottom with html[data-color-scheme='light'] selector. Add comprehensive light mode styles: dark text colors for all text elements, proper bubble colors (dm-message-bubble--other should have dark text on light background #eff3f4), visible secondary text colors, proper hover states with rgba(0,0,0,X%) instead of rgba(255,255,255,X%), proper input backgrounds, visible border colors, etc. (d) Make the back button always display:flex (remove the @media query that hides it on desktop). (e) For the mobile chat input: ensure .dm-message-compose has position:sticky, bottom:0, and appropriate padding-bottom to account for mobile bottom nav (env(safe-area-inset-bottom) or at least 60px safe area). The dm-chat-room-view should use flex-direction:column with the message list taking flex:1 and message-compose being flex-shrink:0 with sticky positioning.
4. Remove the EmptyState component import and usage from index.tsx since we no longer have a right panel that needs a placeholder state.
acceptance_criteria: The DM page shows only the chat room list when no room is selected
Clicking a room navigates to show only the messages view (list disappears)
The back button is visible on all screen sizes, not just mobile
In light mode (html[data-color-scheme='light']), all text is clearly visible: dark text on light backgrounds
Message bubbles from others have dark text (#0f1419 or similar) on light background (#eff3f4)
The message compose area does not scroll away with messages - it stays fixed at the bottom
No @media (prefers-color-scheme: light) selector remains in the SCSS
verification: Run: cd /projects/sandbox/mastodon && npx tsc --noEmit --project tsconfig.json 2>&1 | head -50
Verify no @media (prefers-color-scheme: light) in dm.scss: grep -n 'prefers-color-scheme' app/javascript/styles/mastodon/dm.scss
Verify html[data-color-scheme='light'] is used: grep -n 'data-color-scheme' app/javascript/styles/mastodon/dm.scss
Verify no dm-panel-left/dm-panel-right remain in index.tsx: grep -n 'dm-panel' app/javascript/mastodon/features/dm/index.tsx
